text:
sara: Holding today's release window. Staging CI failing on integration tests and deploy-bot can't fetch the wheel artifact due to auth errors. Blocking promotion.
omar: Error snippets from the runner:
```
CI: curl -fS -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://artifacts.internal/wheels/app-1.4.0.whl -> 401 Unauthorized
CI: pytest tests/integration/test_e2e.py::test_payment_flow --maxfail=1 -q -> ERROR: DB fixture port collision after 3 retries
```
ci-bot: flaky-test-detector: test_payment_flow flakiness score increased: 0.21 -> mark for manual review.
deploy-bot: promote paused: failed artifact fetch (code=401), attempts=3. To force: `/deploybot promote --force R-2026-03-21-2` but that bypasses integrity and auth checks.
kelly: 401 could be due to the short-lived service token we rotated this morning. Ops, did we rotate the artifact-registry token?
ryan: yes rotated at 08:12 UTC, but we updated the runner secret in prod only. Staging got missed. Will patch secret now.
sara: In the meantime, can we pin to the latest deployed digest (sha256:deadbeef) and keep the rest of the release paused? We need a quick customer note.
omar: Pinning is safe. We can roll traffic to the previous image/digest and hold the canary. Risk: if the DB schema in the new release is required, pinning might fail smoke tests.
kelly: Quick check: migration version in new image is v12, previous is v11. Are there DB migrations that run on startup? If so, pinning is okay since v12 only adds backward-compatible columns. Confirming with eng-db.
re:eng-db: migrations are additive, rollback safe.
ryan: secret updated for staging runner. Retrying artifact fetch now.
ci-bot: retrying artifact fetch... status=200, download OK, sha256 matches (a1b2c3d4).
deploy-bot: pre-promote smoke run queued. Note: auto-promote remains suspended per request by sara.
sara: Good. Do a smoke run, but keep the manual promote gate open. I will draft a short release note and send to #release-announcements: "Release delayed: staging artifact fetch failure due to token rotation; pinned previous digest during verification; manual promote pending verification; status ETA ~20m."
kelly: I'll kick a quick integration run against the fetched artifact.
omar: integration run shows one intermittent DB collision fail rerun passed. Looks like test harness race, not production code.
ryan: smoke and integration green. Approving manual promote.
deploy-bot: manual promote command received from sara. Promoting R-2026-03-21-2 -> rolling update policy: canary 10% for 5m then 50% for 10m then 100%.
sara: Thanks all. After rollout completes, I'll update release notes and close the window. Small action items: ryan confirm runner secret rotation for all environments, kelly open a test-flakiness ticket for test_payment_flow, omar add a preflight check for artifact-token validity in CI steps.
kelly: will do.
ryan: I'll propagate rotation to staging-runner group and add a monitor alert if artifact fetch returns 401 more than 1/min.
sara: Closing hold, will update once rollout done. :white_check_mark:
